name: Hart im Zillertal
kurzbeschreibung: Tiny village between Rattenberg and Schlitters – the perfect starting point for exploring the Zillertal.
beschreibung:
Hart im Zillertal extends at an elevation of 650 meters in the Unterland around the Kaisergebirge and the Alpbachtal and is a quiet village community. The village has around 1,600 inhabitants and stretches over a spacious area with typical Tiroler farmhouses and agricultural businesses.

Those seeking relaxation enjoy the quiet and seclusion away from the tourist crowds, and the untouched nature around the village invites extended explorations, while families appreciate the diverse range of leisure activities and child-friendly accommodations.

Hart im Zillertal is especially suitable for families and those seeking relaxation who want to combine quiet with activities. The good transport connections and proximity to larger towns make the stay particularly pleasant.
